review.publicPort: CustomLayerInterface.prerender prepares resources/texture work; render draws into current main framebuffer.
review.hostLifecycle: drawCustom marks tracked state dirty and reapplies base state after either callback. The complete offscreen pass resets main viewport/framebuffer before ordinary rendering.
review.framebuffer: The custom render callback must composite into the currently bound host target. No default-main framebuffer assumption is needed.
review.trackedStateLimit: setDirty does not reset every rawGLstate. Native owned work must establish its required sampler/PBO/rasterizer/sample-coverage state; subsequent custom layers must establish their own inputs.
review.genericPort: The borrowed generic renderer retains full capture/restore; nativeMap adapter uses the explicit publicphase contract, without production imports of privatehost implementations.
review.ordering: Custom layers are excluded from terrain RTTeligible layer types. Main layer order remains the actual customlayer position.
review.plan: Meshless Plan must update projection/pick/frame state in prepare even when it submits no offscreen GPUgeometry.
review.failure: Empty/error/contextloss invalidates frame readiness, preventing old-source colour from being composited.

limits: This is a pinned installed-code/API source audit, not actual pixel/resource/performance qualification.
